content.text: The naive reference is too slow (it re-evaluates predicates per query window). Let me speed it up (keeping identical naive semantics) and shrink fuzz dimensions:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('reference.py').read()
s=s.replace("""            if not all(any(pred(job['predicates'][i], row) for i in cl)
                       for cl in active):
                continue""",
"""            if not all(any(um[u][i] for i in cl) for cl in active):
                continue""")
open('reference.py','w').write(s)
s=open('fuzz.py').read()
s=s.replace("nf = rng.randint(1, 3)","nf = rng.randint(1, 3)")
s=s.replace("size = rng.randint(1, 4)\n        domain = sorted(rng.sample(range(0, 12), size))","size = rng.randint(1, 3)\n        domain = sorted(rng.sample(range(0, 12), size))")
s=s.replace("ntrain = rng.randint(1, 8)","ntrain = rng.randint(1, 6)")
s=s.replace("for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5)):\n        size","for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 4)):\n        size")
s=s.replace("for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5)):\n        fixed","for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 4)):\n        fixed")
open('fuzz.py','w').write(s)
EOF
